title: Orientation
description: auto picks from the page box: a column (status, target, readouts) for upright boxes, a strip (target beside the readouts) for wide ones.

title: Alignment
description: Where the target sits. Column: centred, or flush to the right or left edge of the page. Strip: left (also center) puts the target first, right mirrors the strip for a page on the right of the screen.

title: Dot lifetime
description: How many recent hits stay on the target as dots. The newest 40 are drawn bright; older ones fade. All hits keeps the whole attempt as a dim cloud that brightens where hits cluster. Bias, centre share, spread and the ellipse always cover the whole attempt.

title: Show 1σ ellipse
description: Outline one standard deviation of the hit cloud around its centroid (the attempt's covariance).

title: Keep on results
description: Hold the finished attempt's scatter on the results screen, which shows no cursor accuracy in osu!stable or lazer. Off: show during gameplay only.

title: Backing
description: none floats the target on the game with its own soft lens; scrim adds a soft dark fade behind the whole box; panel draws a graphite panel.

title: Highlight colour
description: Colour of the centroid, ellipse and bias: the map background's tonal accent, or 18-LAB amber. Early/late dot colours never change.
